blocks.x: Educational television plants the seeds of future careers in the young. It cultivates and refreshes the intellect of the adult. It enriches the leisure time of the senior citizen who wants never to stop learning. Contribute to the support of your community station. Send your contribution to WYES-TV, Channel 8, New Orleans 24. The End To open the doors to richness in our lives, we each may choose the best of what has gone before, the best of that which lives today, to fashion us a seed. And from the minds of those who enter in, this gift is given us, our still to give and yet to keep. A gift of value great with life itself. And this, our heritage. In this series of heritage programs, we are privileged to meet Mr. Louis Armstrong, the internationally known New Orleans jazz trumpeter and band leader. In this third program, Mr. Armstrong and his guests, Mr. Robert McCulley, writer and publicist. Mr. Adam Lynch, newscaster, TV personality and classical music broadcaster. And Mr. Benny Benack, jazz trumpeter, band leader, assistant director of the University of Pittsburgh band. We'll discuss Mr. Armstrong and the role as bandstand philosopher.
